To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

Tn antigen expression in scirrhosis carcinoma and STn antigen expression in non‐scirrhois carcinoma are related to pathological prognostic factor and that the expression of these antigens in scirrhosic and non‐scirrhotic carcinomas is different.

mucin antigens expression was different between scirrhous and papillotubulo‐solid carcinoma and Ki‐67 labelling was inversely correlated with nodal metastasis in papillotubuloid carcinoma but not in scirrhosus carcinoma.

mucin‐related antigen expression was correlated to nodal status in scirrhosus subtype of breast cancer and that inverse relationship between Ki‐ 67 labeling and nodals status was observed in papillotublar carcinoma and solid tubular carcinoma of breast cancer.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the expression of mucin antigens and Ki‐67 antigen in IDC.
the relationship between the expression of the mucin antigens (T‐, Tn‐, STn‐, DF3‐, and intestinal‐MRPs) as well as Ki67 labeling and the pathological prognostic factor of breast cancer.
the relationship between mucin‐related antigen expression and Ki‐‐67 labeling and pathological prognostic factor in breast cancer.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
mucin antigen and Ki‐67 expression may be a useful marker for evaluating the biologic behavior of breast cancer, particularly in the case of scirrhous breast carcinoma.
mucin antigen expression and Ki‐ 67 labeling are not only useful for the differential diagnosis of IDC but also have prognostic value in the evaluation of breast cancer.

mucin‐related antigen expression was correlated to the biological aggressiveness of breast cancer, especially SC, whereas Ki‐67 labeling may be a prognostic indicator of breast cancer, particularly of PT‐ST.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
mucin‐related antigen expression and Ki‐66 labeling are useful in predicting the biological behavior of IDC.
Tn antigen expression in SC may be useful in the diagnosis of lymph node metastasis in the early stages of breast cancer.
Tn and STn antigens are useful for the prediction of nodal status and tumor size in breast carcinomas, and Ki‐67 may be useful for the prediction for nodal status in PT‐ST.
The main takeaway from our work is that
Tn and STn antigens expression may be related to nodal metastasis in SC, but STn antigen may be related to lymph node metastasis in PT‐ST.

mucin‐related antigen expression and Ki‐ 67 labeling are useful markers in breast cancer, and the differences in their expression between the SC and PT‐ ST subtypes may reflect their distinct clinical behavior and prognosis.
mucin‐related antigen expression may be related to the pathological prognostic features in breast cancer.
